mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEVICE (device_name, device_type, device_category, model, serial_number, input_channel_1, input_channel_2, output_channel_1, output_channel_2, output_channel_3, max_resolution, max_windows, support_move, support_resize, support_overlay, base_url, online) VALUES (#{device.deviceName}, #{device.deviceType}, #{device.deviceCategory}, #{device.model}, #{device.serialNumber}, #{device.inputChannel1}, #{device.inputChannel2}, #{device.outputChannel1}, #{device.outputChannel2}, #{device.outputChannel3}, #{device.maxResolution}, #{capability.maxWindows}, #{capability.supportMove}, #{capability.supportResize}, #{capability.supportOverlay}, #{baseUrl}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE DEVICE SET enabled = #{enabled}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE DEVICE SET online = #{online}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE DEVICE SET device_name = #{device.deviceName}, device_type = #{device.deviceType}, device_category = #{device.deviceCategory}, model = #{device.model}, serial_number = #{device.serialNumber}, input_channel_1 = #{device.inputChannel1}, input_channel_2 = #{device.inputChannel2}, output_channel_1 = #{device.outputChannel1}, output_channel_2 = #{device.outputChannel2}, output_channel_3 = #{device.outputChannel3}, max_resolution = #{device.maxResolution}, max_windows = #{capability.maxWindows}, support_move = #{capability.supportMove}, support_resize = #{capability.supportResize}, support_overlay = #{capability.supportOverlay}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_name, device_type, device_category, model, serial_number, input_channel_1, input_channel_2, output_channel_1, output_channel_2, output_channel_3, max_resolution, max_windows, support_move, support_resize, support_overlay, base_url, online, enabled, last_heartbeat FROM DEVICE WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, device_name, device_type, device_category, model, serial_number, input_channel_1, input_channel_2, output_channel_1, output_channel_2, output_channel_3, max_resolution, max_windows, support_move, support_resize, support_overlay, base_url, online, enabled, last_heartbeat FROM DEVICE WHERE base_url = #{baseUrl}

SELECT id, device_name, device_type, device_category, model, serial_number, input_channel_1, input_channel_2, output_channel_1, output_channel_2, output_channel_3, max_resolution, max_windows, support_move, support_resize, support_overlay, base_url, online, enabled, last_heartbeat FROM DEVICE ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, device_name, device_type, device_category, model, serial_number, input_channel_1, input_channel_2, output_channel_1, output_channel_2, output_channel_3, max_resolution, max_windows, support_move, support_resize, support_overlay, base_url, online, enabled, last_heartbeat FROM DEVICE
AND device_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
AND device_type = #{deviceType}
ORDER BY id DESC
